description:
Archival release (v1.0.2) of the whole-brain single-neuron atlas analysis pipeline accompanying Mitani T.T. et al., "Whole-Brain Single-Neuron Atlas Reveals a Microglial Security-Hole Pattern" (preprint [earlier version]: https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-5827312/v1), aligned with EMBL-EBI BioImage Archive accession S-BIAD4432 (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/bioimages/studies/S-BIAD4432).

Summary of repository contents:

  • Complete C++/CUDA, Python, and R analysis pipeline, documentation (README.md), CITATION.cff metadata, and Supplementary Table 1.xlsx (27 experimental cohorts / 111 brains; 10x d-MOVIE cell-type imaging and 0.65x macroscopic Abeta imaging; Allen Brain Atlas CCFv3 region abbreviations) aligned with BioImage Archive S-BIAD4432.
  • Peer-review validation notebook suite (script/revision_2026/) mapped to the final manuscript display items (6 Main, 13 Extended Data, and 30 Supplementary Figures).
